# The Rittenhouse Residence

> An 8-bedroom Victorian mansion at 1822 Pine Street in Center City Philadelphia,
> available as a whole-home vacation rental for large groups. First sold in 1854,
> nearly 7,000 square feet across five floors, two blocks from Rittenhouse Square.
> Sleeps up to 16 guests. From $1,600 per night for the entire house.

Canonical site: https://rittenhouseresidence.com

## Property facts

- Address: 1822 Pine Street, Philadelphia, PA 19103 (Rittenhouse Square, Center City)
- Type: entire historic townhouse — guests always book the whole house, never rooms
- Bedrooms: 8 (3 king, 4 queen, 1 double) across floors 2–4
- Bathrooms: 5 full baths and a powder room
- Floors: 5, including a private furnished roof deck; no elevator
- Size: nearly 7,000 square feet
- Dining: seats the full group at one table; two parlors; full-size pool table
- Kitchens: 2 full kitchens (primary on the parlor floor, secondary upstairs)
- Amenities: fast WiFi (351 Mbps measured), central air and heat, washer/dryer, smart TVs, linens included
- Rates: from $1,600/night for the whole house; 2-night minimum (longer on peak dates)
- Payments: 50% deposit at reservation, balance due 60 days before arrival
- Check-in 4:00 PM · Check-out 10:00 AM
- House rules: no parties or events, no smoking anywhere, no pets, quiet hours apply
- Licensed Philadelphia short-term rental; exterior security cameras only
- Parking: paid garages within two blocks (options sent before check-in); the house
  fronts Pine Street with Waverly Street behind for luggage drop-off

## Best suited for

Family reunions, milestone birthdays and anniversaries, friends' getaways,
holiday gatherings, and out-of-town wedding-guest housing — any group that wants
to stay together under one roof instead of splitting across hotel rooms.

## Booking

- Live availability and checkout: https://www.vrbo.com/757481
- Airbnb (4.88, 102 reviews, Guest Favorite, Superhost, as of Aug 2026): https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/6000930
- Vrbo (9.8/10 "Exceptional", 66 reviews, as of Aug 2026): https://www.vrbo.com/757481
- Booking is available ONLY through Airbnb and Vrbo. There is no direct-checkout
  path; direct inquiries are answered within 24 hours but the reservation is
  completed on one of those two platforms.
- Direct inquiries: https://rittenhouseresidence.com/contact (response within 24 hours)

## History (documented from deeds and newspapers)

- First documented sale: April 21, 1854 — John McCrea conveyed the lot to merchant
  newly completed townhouse to merchant John Roset.
- Drexel connection: the Rosets' daughter Ellen married financier Anthony J. Drexel
  in 1850; the family owned 1822 Pine for decades.
- 1899: alterations and additions for Mrs. Agnes Spencer, attributed to architects
  Duhring, Okie & Ziegler (contemporary newspaper notices).
- 1910s: documented women's-suffrage activity — Equal Franchise Society ticket
  sales from the house (1915) and a documented December 1913 suffrage
  tax-resistance episode by a resident.
- 1922–1952: divided into apartments, then restored to a single residence.
- 1995: contributing property in the Rittenhouse–Fitler Residential Historic
  District (Philadelphia Register of Historic Places).
- The site publishes 63 primary-source documents (deeds, newspaper clippings) and
  a 14-chapter history.

## Common questions

- What is the minimum stay? The standard minimum is 2 nights. Peak weekends,
  holidays, and high-demand periods may require a longer stay.
- What deposit is required? A 50% deposit is required at reservation. The
  remaining balance is due 60 days before arrival.
- What is the cancellation policy? Cancellations require 60 days notice for a
  full refund of the deposit.
- What happens if I cancel less than 60 days before arrival? Inside 60 days the
  deposit is no longer refundable under the standard policy. The same rule
  appears before checkout, so there are no surprises after you reserve.
- Can I book directly? Yes. Send an inquiry through the contact page with your
  dates and group size — we confirm availability and hold dates within 24
  hours, with no platform service fees. Vrbo remains available for instant
  online checkout.
- How many guests can stay? The house sleeps up to 16 guests across 8 bedrooms
  and 5 full bathrooms and a powder room.
- What time is check-in and check-out? Check-in is 4:00 PM and check-out is
  10:00 AM. Early arrival or late departure may be available only when the
  calendar allows it.
- Are parties allowed? No. The house is for registered overnight guests and is
  not suitable for parties. It is guest lodging only — not a ceremony,
  reception, or event venue. Wedding groups use it to house out-of-town guests,
  not to host the event itself.
- Are pets allowed? No. Pets are not permitted at the residence.
